justification: Corrects served regulatory numbers in dcp_setback_controls against their source PDFs: canada_bay 701 served a rear setback 4x under the actual control (1.5m vs C9's 6.0m); ryde's general front setback (6m) and burwood's general side setback existed nowhere, so nothing could have caught a wrong stand-in; fairfield served Chapter-5C narrow-lot values under secondary_dwelling. Every value write carries the verbatim quote supporting the new value in the same statement (extraction-doc rule 2b), was backed up per-row with a printed rollback, and was guarded on the pre-state read at plan time. Also closes the truncation-detection escape (a 400-char quote ending in punctuation was judged on severed evidence) and syncs the secondary_street_setback vocabulary across SQL, Python and the TS display maps so 20 served rows stop rendering under 'Other'.

falsifiable_check.passes_when: every stored control value is derivable from its own source_text by a named rule or sits in the shrink-only baseline; no served row carries a self-declared assumption; the SQL CHECK constraint, the Python CANONICAL_CONTROL_TYPES set and (via the database-marked test) every distinct control_type in production agree; and a quote at exactly the 400-char extractor cap is TRUNCATED_EVIDENCE regardless of its final character
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a repaired row's quote no longer supports its value (rule 2b regression — this exact failure fired on camden 690 when only the value was corrected); the baseline is grown without --allow-growth; secondary_street_setback is removed from either side of the vocabulary sync; or the punctuation exemption is reintroduced into evidence_is_truncated
falsifiable_check.demonstrated_failing: test_a_quote_at_the_limit_is_truncated_even_ending_in_punctuation asserts evidence_is_truncated('x'*399 + '.') — under the pre-change code this exact assertion fails (the old code returned False for punctuation-terminated 400-char quotes), which is the escape Sol identified. Conversely test_a_short_quote_is_never_truncated fails if the fix overshoots to length-independent truncation. Live DB before/after: canada_bay 701 value_min 1.5->6.0 with quote 'C9. All development...'; detector category A 28->3, category B 6->0; checker exit 0, baseline 41->38 shrink-only.
falsifiable_check.mutation_evidence: evidence_is_truncated hardcoded False -> the mid-word and punctuation tests fail; hardcoded True -> the short-quote/None/empty tests fail. Dropping secondary_street_setback from CANONICAL_CONTROL_TYPES -> test_migration_matches_python_vocabulary fails AND test_every_db_control_type_is_canonical fails against production (20 live rows). Reverting 701's value in the DB while keeping the C9 quote -> the value 1.5 is not derivable from the C9 quote and the row is not baselined -> checker exits non-zero.
